issues.description: StockIngredient constructor parameter lists differ between artifacts. The problem statement UML and the solution implement a 3-argument constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). The template implementation only provides a 4-argument constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity, boolean strictValidation) and does not define the 3-argument overload. Because the template lacks the 3-arg constructor required by the specification and used in example/solution code, student code or tests that instantiate StockIngredient with three arguments will fail to compile and will be unable to follow the exercise instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Add the expected 3-argument constructor to the template: public StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). Implement it so it either delegates to the existing 4-arg constructor (e.g., passing a sensible default for strictValidation) or replace the 4-arg variant with a 3-arg constructor whose validation/behavior matches the specification and the solution. This ensures student code and tests that instantiate StockIngredient(name, price, quantity) compile and behave as described in the problem statement.
